prompt_base: Concept art of a single small cartoon poop prop for a cozy low-poly 3D island virtual pet game, cute and clean, not gross. Match exactly the art style of the reference screenshots: simple chunky rounded shapes, flat toon shading with three tones, soft saturated colors, no outlines, no realistic texture. It is a swirl of stacked coils, each smaller and higher, with a little bent tip on top. Show only the poop, full object in frame, three-quarter view from slightly above, on a plain light grey background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no logo, no face, no eyes, no characters, no flies.

variantes.prompt: Three coils in two alternating browns, milk chocolate and a darker brown, with a pointy tip leaning to one side.
Three very round puffy coils in a warm caramel brown with a soft lighter highlight on top of each coil, like soft serve.
Three coils in a dark earthy brown with a couple of tiny green grass bits stuck on it, as if it fell on the island grass.
A wide low pile of two flattened coils and a small curled tip, in medium brown with slightly darker grooves between the coils.
